The '''1728 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 15th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[Emara]] across [[Ayuma]], and was won by [[Emara]], who defeated [[Taval]] 1-0 in the final.

The 1728 edition reverted to the sixteen-team field used at every tournament before [[1724 FLLA World Cup|1724]], the 24-team format having been rolled back by the FLLA Council on cost grounds in March 1726. Hosted by [[Emara]], the tournament was won by the hosts for the second time, with [[Taval]] taken to a 1-0 defeat in the final at the principal venue in Emara's federal capital. The Emaran side conceded only twice across six fixtures and remain the only host nation to have lifted the trophy without trailing in any match of the tournament.
